items.title: Public Health Starts With Nutritious Food: Health Minister
items.summary: Health Minister Dzulkefly Ahmad said public health starts with safe, nutritious food, calling local agricultural production the “first line of defence” against disease. items.title: Malaysia’s Poisoned Chalice Of Nicotine Vape: First Lacuna, Now An Accidental ‘Ban’
items.summary: Only 2 preparations of nicotine are exempt from the Poisons List: tobacco and nicotine patch/gum. Amid Madani's silence, the industry has a "grace period" until GE16 to get rid of nicotine vape stock before a potential instant ban by a new government.
